verdict.rationale: Sardine documents initial and ongoing daily Adverse Media screening (sardine-docs-16). Its marketing describes AI agents that do supporting research and route higher-risk matches to analysts with explainable scores, plus a case-management workspace for reviewing alerts (sardine-docs-18, sardine-docs-21, sardine-docs-26). This shows matches can be reviewed, but nothing shows adverse-media results carry linked source evidence (e.g., article links) or risk-category tagging. missing for 10: documented linked source evidence on adverse-media matches, adverse-media risk categories/taxonomy, an adverse-media-specific review UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
